panels.title: Token usage by hour
panels.description: Tokens per hour, summed across all sessions and stacked by class. cache_read normally dwarfs the rest — that's prompt-cache reuse, not new context.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "claude_code")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "tokens")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "input_tokens" or r._field == "output_tokens" or r._field == "cache_creation_tokens" or r._field == "cache_read_tokens")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.project =~ /^${project:regex}$/)
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Highest usage in a session
panels.description: Top 10 sessions by total tokens (input + output + cache) over the selected range.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "claude_code")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "tokens" and r._field == "total_tokens")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.project =~ /^${project:regex}$/)
  |> group(columns: ["session", "project"])
  |> sum()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 10)
  |> keep(columns: ["project", "session", "_value"])

panels.title: Cache vs real tokens
panels.description: Cached tokens (cache read + cache create) vs real billed context (input + output) over the selected range. A high cache share means context is being reused efficiently.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "claude_code")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "tokens")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "input_tokens" or r._field == "output_tokens" or r._field == "cache_creation_tokens" or r._field == "cache_read_tokens")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.project =~ /^${project:regex}$/)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with kind: if r._field == "cache_read_tokens" or r._field == "cache_creation_tokens" then "cache" else "real" }))
  |> group(columns: ["kind"])
  |> sum()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: [], columnKey: ["kind"], valueColumn: "_value")
